description: Agent Capacity: submit an agent’s work queue with its service target: the queue with its id, name, the longest an item should wait before work starts in hours and the depth at which it counts as full; each depth sample with its date or time, the depth recorded and optionally the arrivals and completions since the previous sample; each item with its id, what it is, when it entered and when work on it started; and the moment the queue is read at. The signed report gives the queue, the depth at the first and last sample with the change, the direction (growing, steady or shrinking) and the arrivals against the completions where every sample records both, every item with its wait before work started, or until the reading moment while it waits, and whether that passes the target, the median and longest wait with the share within target, and the recorded last depth beside the items the records show waiting then, and counts them, and names a backed-up queue: items still waiting past the target wait, a depth that grew by a fifth or more across the window or from empty, and a depth over the limit; then a smaller rise, items that started past the target and a recorded depth that differs from the items, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No target wait, fewer than two depth samples, no items or no reading moment for items still waiting leaves the queue unverified. This reads a queue’s depth and waits against its service target: whether waiting items are re-reviewed at their review point is wever_triage-aging-check, the order items are ranked in is wever_triage-priority-check and the uptime and credit terms in an SLA text are wever_sla-evidence-check. Verdict capacity_queue_backed_up, capacity_queue_partial, capacity_queue_unverified or capacity_queue_flowing. POST /api/capacity-queue-check. Reads the load and capacity records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Capacity reads an agent’s own load and capacity records and checks the load against the capacity that exists: work in hand against the stated limit, a queue against its target wait, concurrent runs against the cap, an allowance’s burn against its period, a backlog across a window, spare capacity against the reserve, the scaling plan against the burn, and admission at capacity against written priority rules. Beside it, the Agent Limits checks such as wever_limit-substrate-check read whether a limit sits in code or in prose and how it is scoped, changed and seen, while a capacity check reads the load itself against the capacity; wever_commitment-deadline-check reads promised hours against due dates, while the workload check reads the work in hand against the stated limit over time; and the Agent Triage checks such as wever_triage-priority-check read how queue items are ranked, reviewed and closed, while the queue, backlog and throttle checks read waits, size and admission against capacity. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-capacity-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-capacity/.

items.description: Items in the queue over the window.

entered.description: A date or time, such as 2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T14:00Z.

started.description: When work on it began, such as 2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T14:00Z.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

depth_limit.description: The depth at which the queue counts as full.

target_wait_hours.description: The longest an item should wait before work starts, in hours.

read_at.description: The moment the queue is read at, such as 2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T14:00Z.

samples.description: Queue depth as recorded over time.

arrivals.description: Items that arrived since the previous sample.

at.description: A date or time, such as 2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T14:00Z.

completions.description: Items finished since the previous sample.

name: wever_capacity-queue-check
title: Capacity queue check
